title: the /chart skill asks CodeMother's chart verb
intention: The /chart skill writes and floors its stages through CodeMother's chart verb: live.py gains floor and write subcommands that ask her, and SKILL.md's fourteen import blocks become those commands.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: skills/chart/SKILL.md instructs fourteen imports of cairn.devices.codemother.machines (lines 48 to 577); RULE 1 says nothing outside a device reaches into its code, skills included.
how: Add `floor <stage> <input>` and `write <stage> <packet.json>` to skills/chart/live.py, each one _ask_codemother('chart', ...); replace every import block in SKILL.md with the command. Red-first proof.

clauses.claim: skills/chart/SKILL.md and skills/chart/live.py name no cairn.devices.codemother module
live.py floor <stage> <input> sends one chart request op floor and prints her packet
live.py write <stage> <packet.json> sends one chart request op write with the file's packet and prints her berth
a refusal makes either subcommand exit nonzero with her reason

decisions.text: D1: skills/chart/live.py: _floor(argv) and _write(argv) dispatched from _main, each through _ask_codemother('chart', {stage, op, input}); a refusal prints the reason and returns 1.
D2: skills/chart/SKILL.md: each of the fourteen python import blocks becomes the matching live.py floor or write command.
D3: the proof skills/chart/proofs/test_the_chart_skill_asks_codemothers_chart_verb.py, red-first, PROVES 1-4; it drives _main with a recording _ask_codemother; the house runner.
